# Ion channel conduction audit (generated by experiments/audit_channel_conduction.py — do not edit by hand)

Generated by `experiments/audit_channel_conduction.py` on 2026-10-17 at commit d3b6386 from data/processed/graph_full_neuronal_split_binders_drugs_v5, data/raw/uniprot/uniprot_human_reviewed.tsv.gz, data/raw/gene_ontology/goa_human.gaf.gz, data/raw/gene_ontology/go-basic.obo; do not edit by hand.

Graph `data/processed/graph_full_neuronal_split_binders_drugs_v5`. 438 reviewed human proteins carry monoatomic ion channel activity (GO:0005216, propagated); 365 of their genes are nodes of the graph. A channel conducts when a reaction it catalyses, directly or as a member of a Reactome entity, feeds the membrane potential (`changes_membrane_potential` into VM_c); otherwise its gene reaches the rest of the graph only through what else it touches. The classes are defined in the script's docstring.
